compute: RTX 3090 24GB; AMP; gradient accumulation; frozen or PEFT ViT-B-scale EO VFM; single-card first
input_resolution: 120x120 native Copernicus-Bench patches; 96x96 DFC2020 extension only if licensed; no 512+ global tiles
screening_budget: 5-15 epochs per candidate, batch 16-32 at 120x120 where the audited checkpoint permits; otherwise batch 8 with accumulation
formal_budget_after_route_approval: 20-50 epochs, 3 seeds only after matched baseline and route screen pass
trainable_parameter_target: under 10M for router/adapters/decoder; frozen trunk or identical last-block mask across controls
data_cap: core raw + labels + extracted copy + caches + checkpoints + necessary downloads <=50GB; hard-stop pre-download at 45GB
wall_clock_requirement: measure peak VRAM, throughput and wall latency; do not infer efficiency from FLOPs
